description: This file defines functions to interact with a Projects API, specifically for retrieving project summaries. It imports utility functions from other modules, constructs API requests with query parameters based on input, and returns the API response data.

methods.name: getProjectsSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a summary of projects created within specified time ranges, with support for custom date ranges and automatic inclusion of organization identifiers in headers and query parameters.
